mode.description: Operation mode: 'server' for lcshare, 'client' for lcsync

interface.description: Network interface to use. Empty for all interfaces.

password.description: Encryption password used to derive the symmetric key.

keyfile.description: Path to a 128-byte random key file for encryption.

bw_limit.description: Bandwidth limit with SI prefix (e.g., '10M', '1G'). Empty for unlimited.

hex_hashes.description: Print file hashes in hexadecimal format.

archive.description: Set owner, group, permissions, and times on destination.

dry_run.description: Perform a trial run with no files transferred.

batch.description: Run in batch mode without prompting.

local_path.description: Local file or directory path involved in the sync.

remote_path.description: Remote file or directory path to sync with. Empty for local-to-local.

loopback.description: Enable multicast loopback for server mode.
